title: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years
native_title: 機動戦艦ナデシコ Ｔｈｅ ｂｌａｎｋ ｏｆ ３ｙｅａｒｓ
overview: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: The Blank of 3 Years is a sound novel-style adventure game based on the Martian Successor Nadesico anime series. As the name suggests, it describes the events that occur in the in-universe three years between the TV series and the later movie. Gameplay consists of text descriptions of events over full-screen illustrations, with fully-voiced character dialogue. There are occasional choices presented which affect how certain scenes play out, but do not affect the overall progression of the story.
